mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 8.0% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 95.0 (INDPRO < 95.0) signals manufacturing output contraction that increases stagflation risk, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong payroll employment growth (PAYEMS > 100,000 monthly increase) supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth > 100,000, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 650,000 units (HOUST < 650.0) indicate weak housing market demand, reducing overall economic activity and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 650.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and CPI (CPIAUCSL > 2.0%) signal monetary tightening amid inflation, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales above 400,000 million dollars (RSAFS > 400000.0) indicate robust consumer spending that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS > 400000.0, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.
